LESSON: NIMPENDAYE

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.23: Nimpendaye

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo ni somo la kusoma: Nimpendaye. Soma maelezo, fuata mifano iliyofanyiwa kazi, kisha fanya mazoezi.

SEHEMU 2: MALENGO

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. explain what Nimpendaye means in simple pupil language
2. give 3 correct examples of Nimpendaye from Kenya
3. practise Nimpendaye in clear steps
4. apply Nimpendaye in one real-life situation this week

SEHEMU 3: SOMO (MAELEZO NA MIFANO)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: NIMPENDAYE
Subject: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES · Grade: Grade 3
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Nimpendaye helps you succeed in KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

KEY FACTS: NIMPENDAYE
Study Nimpendaye like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain what Nimpendaye means in simple pupil language

What this means
In this part you learn to explain what Nimpendaye means in simple pupil language. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain what Nimpendaye means in simple pupil language.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kusoma: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Nimpendaye”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain what Nimpendaye means in simple pupil language. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Give 3 correct examples of Nimpendaye from Kenya

What this means
In this part you learn to give 3 correct examples of Nimpendaye from Kenya. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: give 3 correct examples of Nimpendaye from Kenya.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kuzungumza: Zungumza na rafiki kwa dakika 1 kuhusu Nimpendaye.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can give 3 correct examples of Nimpendaye from Kenya. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Practise Nimpendaye in clear steps

What this means
In this part you learn to practise Nimpendaye in clear steps. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: practise Nimpendaye in clear steps.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kuandika: Andika sentensi 3 sahihi kuhusu Nimpendaye.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can practise Nimpendaye in clear steps. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Apply Nimpendaye in one real-life situation this week

What this means
In this part you learn to apply Nimpendaye in one real-life situation this week. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply Nimpendaye in one real-life situation this week.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kusoma: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Nimpendaye”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply Nimpendaye in one real-life situation this week. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Nimpendaye is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO YA HARAKA

Example 1: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Nimpendaye”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako. (skill: explain what Nimpendaye means in simple pupil language)

Example 2: Zungumza na rafiki kwa dakika 1 kuhusu Nimpendaye. (skill: give 3 correct examples of Nimpendaye from Kenya)

Example 3: Andika sentensi 3 sahihi kuhusu Nimpendaye. (skill: practise Nimpendaye in clear steps)

Example 4: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Nimpendaye”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako. (skill: apply Nimpendaye in one real-life situation this week)

SEHEMU 5: MAZOEZI

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Nimpendaye to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain what Nimpendaye means in simple pupil language.
3. Practise this skill: give 3 correct examples of Nimpendaye from Kenya.
4. Practise this skill: practise Nimpendaye in clear steps.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Nimpendaye from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA NYUMBANI

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Nimpendaye: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 3 learner study Nimpendaye?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. Know what Nimpendaye means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain what Nimpendaye means in simple pupil language.
5. Be able to: give 3 correct examples of Nimpendaye from Kenya.

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
